item.title: US Cracks Down on AI Chip Smuggling and Export Rules
item.description: The Trump administration adds licensing rules for overseas data centers and expands chip export bans, targeting Nvidia H100 smuggling to China.

item.title: Cantwell Criticizes Commerce for Nvidia AI Chip Leak
item.description: Senator Maria Cantwell says the Commerce Department let advanced Nvidia AI chips flow to China, threatening U.S. national security and its AI edge.
